title.zh: 卷二十四 本紀第二十四 莊烈帝二
title.raw: 卷二十四 本紀第二十四 莊烈帝二 Volume 24 Annals 24: Emperor Zhuanglie 2

sentences.zh: 【莊烈帝二】

translations.literal: Emperor Zhuanglie 2.
translations.idiomatic: Annals of Emperor Zhuanglie, Part Two.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月丁丑，洪承疇敗賊於梓潼，賊還走陝西。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, spring, first month, day dingchou: Hong Chengchou defeated the bandits at Zitong; the bandits retreated fleeing to Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the eleventh year, on dingchou of the first month, Hong Chengchou routed the rebels at Zitong, and they fled back into Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，裁南京冗官。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: redundant Nanjing officials were cut.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai superfluous posts in the Nanjing administration were abolished.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰，改河南巡按御史張任學為總兵官。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiachen: Henan touring investigating censor Zhang Renxue was changed to regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiachen, Zhang Renxue, the touring investigating censor of Henan, was transferred to serve as regional commander.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，賀逢聖致仕。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuyin: He Fengsheng retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuyin, He Fengsheng retired.

sentences.zh: 是月，李自成自洮州出番地，總兵官曹變蛟追破之，復入塞，走西和、禮縣。

translations.literal: That month, Li Zicheng came out of Fan lands from Taozhou; regional commander Cao Bianjiao pursued and defeated him; he again entered the passes and fled to Xihe and Li County.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Zicheng emerged from the Tibetan frontier at Taozhou; regional commander Cao Bianjiao pursued him, broke his force, and drove him back through the passes toward Xihe and Li County.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，張獻忠偽降於穀城，熊文燦受之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinchou: Zhang Xianzhong feigned surrender at Gucheng; Xiong Wencan accepted him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinchou, Zhang Xianzhong pretended to submit at Gucheng, and Xiong Wencan accepted the surrender.

sentences.zh: 戊申，張至發致仕。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Zhang Zhifa retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Zhang Zhifa retired.

sentences.zh: 己酉，熒惑逆行，諭廷臣修省。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Mars moved retrograde; the court ministers were instructed to practice self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Mars was seen in retrograde, and the emperor charged his ministers to examine themselves and reform.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥朔，策試考選官于中左門。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guihai new moon: selected examination officials were examined by policy test at the Central Left Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai new moon of the fifth month the court tested selected examination officials by policy essay at the Central Left Gate.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，安民廠災，壞城垣，傷萬餘人。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guisi: the Anmin Works suffered disaster, damaging the city wall; more than ten thousand were injured.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guisi, fire broke out at the Anmin Works, breaching the city wall and wounding more than ten thousand people.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，孔貞運致仕。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Kong Zhenyun retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Kong Zhenyun retired.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，兵部尚書楊嗣昌、戶部尚書程國祥、禮部侍郎方逢年、工部侍郎蔡國用俱禮部尚書，大理少卿範復粹為禮部侍郎，並兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Minister of War Yang Sichang, Minister of Revenue Cheng Guoxiang, Vice Minister of Rites Fang Fengnian, and Vice Minister of Works Cai Guoyong were all made Ministers of Rites; Vice Minister of Punishments Fan Fucui was made Vice Minister of Rites; all concurrently were Grand Secretaries of the Eastern Lodge, participating in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Minister of War Yang Sichang, Minister of Revenue Cheng Guoxiang, Vice Minister of Rites Fang Fengnian, and Vice Minister of Works Cai Guoyong were all promoted to minister of rites; vice minister of punishments Fan Fucui was made vice minister of rites; all five were also appointed grand secretaries of the Eastern Lodge with seats in confidential state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 嗣昌仍掌兵部。

translations.literal: Sichang still held charge of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Sichang retained control of the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 是月，兩畿、山東、河南大旱蝗。

translations.literal: That month, the two capitals regions, Shandong, and Henan suffered great drought and locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That month severe drought and locust swarms struck the two metropolitan regions, Shandong, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑，少詹事黃道周以論楊嗣昌奪情，謫按察司照磨。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yichou: Junior Mentor Huang Daozhou, for criticizing Yang Sichang's leaving mourning, was demoted to assistant registrar of the surveillance commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yichou, Junior Mentor Huang Daozhou was demoted to surveillance commission assistant registrar for attacking Yang Sichang over his premature return from mourning.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，以災異屢見，齋居永壽宮，諭廷臣修省。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuxu: because disasters and anomalies repeatedly appeared, he fasted in seclusion at Yongshou Palace and instructed the court ministers to practice self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuxu, as omens and disasters mounted, the emperor withdrew to ritual seclusion at Yongshou Palace and again charged his ministers to examine themselves and reform.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，傅冠致仕。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Fu Guan retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Fu Guan retired.

sentences.zh: 戊午，停刑。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu judicial executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 流賊羅汝才等自陝州犯襄陽。

translations.literal: Roving bandit Luo Rucai and others from Shaanzhou invaded Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: The roving rebel Luo Rucai and others marched from Shaanzhou against Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 九月，陝西、山西旱饑。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Shaanxi and Shanxi suffered drought and famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month drought and famine gripped Shaanxi and Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，大清兵入牆子嶺，總督薊遼兵部侍郎吳阿衡死之。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Great Qing troops entered Qiangziling; Grand Coordinator of Jizhou and Liaodong and Vice Minister of War Wu Aheng died there.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Great Qing forces crossed at Qiangziling; Jizhou-Liaodong grand coordinator and vice minister of war Wu Aheng was killed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the capital was placed under martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the capital was placed under martial law.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳，盧象升入援，召對於武英殿。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guisi: Lu Xiangsheng entered to reinforce; he was summoned for audience at the Hall of Martial Eminence.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guisi, Lu Xiangsheng marched in with reinforcements and was received in audience at the Hall of Martial Eminence.

sentences.zh: 甲午，括馬。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: horses were conscripted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the court requisitioned horses for war.

sentences.zh: 盧象升、高起潛分督援軍。

translations.literal: Lu Xiangsheng and Gao Qiqian divided command of the relief armies.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xiangsheng and Gao Qiqian were given joint charge of the relief armies.

sentences.zh: 是月，洪承疇、曹變蛟大破賊于潼關南原，李自成以數騎遁。

translations.literal: That month, Hong Chengchou and Cao Bianjiao greatly defeated the bandits at the Southern Plain of Tong Pass; Li Zicheng escaped with a few horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hong Chengchou and Cao Bianjiao routed the rebels on the southern plain at Tong Pass, and Li Zicheng fled with only a handful of horsemen.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊辰，大清兵克高陽，致仕大學士孫承宗死之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuchen: Great Qing troops took Gaoyang; retired Grand Secretary Sun Chengzong died there.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuchen, Great Qing forces took Gaoyang, and retired grand secretary Sun Chengzong was killed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，罷盧象升，戴罪立功。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Lu Xiangsheng was dismissed; he was allowed to redeem fault through merit.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Lu Xiangsheng was removed from command but ordered to redeem himself through service.

sentences.zh: 劉宇亮自請視師，許之。

translations.literal: Liu Yuliang himself requested to take command in person; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuliang volunteered to take the field in person, and the court assented.

sentences.zh: 是月，羅汝才降。

translations.literal: That month, Luo Rucai surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: That month Luo Rucai submitted.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，方逢年罷。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengzi: Fang Fengnian was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengzi, Fang Fengnian was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 盧象升兵敗于巨鹿，死之。

translations.literal: Lu Xiangsheng's army was defeated at Julu; he died there.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xiangsheng was defeated at Julu and killed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，孫傳庭為兵部侍郎督援軍。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Sun Chuanting was made Vice Minister of War to supervise the relief armies.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Sun Chuanting was appointed vice minister of war to direct the relief armies.

sentences.zh: 征洪承疇入衛。

translations.literal: Hong Chengchou was summoned to enter and guard the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Chengchou was recalled to help defend the capital.

sentences.zh: 是年，土魯番、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year Turfan and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Turfan and Ryukyu sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月己未朔，以時事多艱，卻廷臣賀。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, spring, first month, day jiwei new moon: because the times were full of hardship, court ministers' congratulations were declined.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the twelfth year, on the jiwei new moon of the first month, the emperor declined the usual New Year congratulations from his ministers, citing the nation's hard times.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大清兵入濟南，德王由樞被執，布政使張秉文等死之。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Great Qing troops entered Jinan; the Prince of De Zhu Youshu was captured; administrative commissioner Zhang Bingwen and others died there.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Great Qing forces entered Jinan; Prince Zhu Youshu of De was taken prisoner, and administrative commissioner Zhang Bingwen and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，劉宇亮、孫傳庭會師十八萬于晉州，不敢進。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Liu Yuliang and Sun Chuanting united armies of one hundred eighty thousand at Jinzhou and dared not advance.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Liu Yuliang and Sun Chuanting assembled one hundred eighty thousand men at Jinzhou but dared not move forward.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，改洪承疇總督薊、遼，孫傳庭總督保定、山東、河北。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Hong Chengchou was changed to grand coordinator of Ji and Liao; Sun Chuanting was made grand coordinator of Baoding, Shandong, and Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Hong Chengchou was reassigned as grand coordinator of Ji and Liao, and Sun Chuanting as grand coordinator of Baoding, Shandong, and Hebei.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，劉宇亮罷。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiwei: Liu Yuliang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yiwei, Liu Yuliang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 大清兵北歸。

translations.literal: Great Qing troops returned north.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Qing army withdrew northward.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅，出青山口。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingyin: they went out through Qingshan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingyin, they marched out through Qingshan Pass.

sentences.zh: 凡深入二千里，閱五月，下畿內、山東七十餘城。

translations.literal: Altogether they penetrated two thousand li, passing through five months, and took more than seventy cities in the capital regions and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In all they had thrust two thousand li inland over five months and seized more than seventy cities in the metropolitan region and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 丙子，加上孝純皇太后諡，詔天下。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the posthumous title was added to Empress Dowager Xiaochun; an edict was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the empress dowager Xiaochun was given her full posthumous honorific, and the decree was promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，程國祥致仕。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wushen: Cheng Guoxiang retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wushen, Cheng Guoxiang retired.

sentences.zh: 是月，左良玉擊降賊首李萬慶。

translations.literal: That month, Zuo Liangyu attacked and induced the rebel chieftain Li Wanqing to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zuo Liangyu attacked and forced the rebel chief Li Wanqing to submit.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，禮部侍郎姚明恭、張四知，兵部侍郎魏照乘，俱禮部尚書兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiazi: Vice Ministers of Rites Yao Minggong and Zhang Sizhi, and Vice Minister of War Wei Zhaosheng were all made Ministers of Rites concurrently Grand Secretaries of the Eastern Lodge, participating in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiazi, Rites vice ministers Yao Minggong and Zhang Sizhi and war vice minister Wei Zhaosheng were all made ministers of rites and grand secretaries of the Eastern Lodge with seats in confidential deliberations.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，張獻忠叛于穀城，羅汝才等起應之，陷房縣。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Zhang Xianzhong rebelled at Gucheng; Luo Rucai and others rose in response; Fang County fell.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Zhang Xianzhong rose again at Gucheng; Luo Rucai and others answered his call, and Fang County was taken.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，削孫傳庭籍，尋逮下獄。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Sun Chuanting was struck from the roster; soon he was arrested and cast into prison.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Sun Chuanting was stripped of rank; soon afterward he was arrested and imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 六月，畿內、山東、河南、山西旱蝗。

translations.literal: Sixth month: the capital regions, Shandong, Henan, and Shanxi suffered drought and locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month drought and locusts ravaged the metropolitan region, Shandong, Henan, and Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 己酉，抽練各鎮精兵，復加征練餉。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: picked elite troops from the various garrisons were drilled; the training levy was again increased.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou elite detachments were drawn from the garrisons for drill, and the training levy was imposed again.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，左良玉討張獻忠，敗績于羅猴山，總兵官羅岱被執死之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renshen: Zuo Liangyu campaigned against Zhang Xianzhong and suffered defeat at Luohou Mountain; regional commander Luo Dai was captured and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renshen, Zuo Liangyu marched against Zhang Xianzhong and was routed at Luohou Mountain; regional commander Luo Dai was captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 熊文燦削籍，尋逮下獄。

translations.literal: Xiong Wencan was struck from the roster; soon he was arrested and cast into prison.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong Wencan was stripped of rank and soon imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，詔誅封疆失事巡撫都御史顏繼祖，總兵官倪寵、祖寬，內臣鄧希詔、孫茂霖等三十三人，俱棄市。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guisi: an edict ordered the execution of frontier-failure grand coordinator and censor-in-chief Yan Jizu, regional commanders Ni Chong and Zu Kuan, inner attendants Deng Xizhao, Sun Maolin, and thirty-three others in all; all were executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guisi, the court decreed the execution of grand coordinator Yan Jizu and thirty-two other officials who had failed on the frontiers—including regional commanders Ni Chong and Zu Kuan and eunuchs Deng Xizhao and Sun Maolin—all of whom were put to death in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 己亥，免唐縣等四十州縣去年田租之半。

translations.literal: Day jihai: half of last year's land tax was remitted for forty prefectures and counties including Tang County.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai half of the previous year's land tax was remitted in forty prefectures and counties, including Tang.

sentences.zh: 壬子，大學士楊嗣昌督師討賊，總督以下並聽節制。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Grand Secretary Yang Sichang supervised the armies to campaign against the bandits; grand coordinators and below all obeyed his command.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Grand Secretary Yang Sichang was placed in supreme command of the campaign against the rebels, with all grand coordinators and subordinate commanders under his orders.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申朔，楊嗣昌誓師襄陽。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiashen new moon: Yang Sichang swore the host at Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen new moon of the tenth month of winter Yang Sichang took command at a grand assembly in Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 甲午，左良玉為平賊將軍。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Zuo Liangyu was made General for Pacifying Bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Zuo Liangyu was appointed General for Pacifying the Bandits.

sentences.zh: 丙申，《欽定保民四事全書》成，頒佈天下。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: the Imperially Approved Complete Book of the Four Affairs for Protecting the People was completed and distributed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the Imperially Approved Complete Book of the Four Affairs for Protecting the People was finished and promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛巳，祀天於南郊。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinsi: Heaven was sacrificed to at the southern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinsi, the emperor offered sacrifice to Heaven at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 十二月，羅汝才犯四川。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Luo Rucai invaded Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Luo Rucai raided into Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 丙午，下兵部尚書傅宗龍於獄。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Minister of War Fu Zonglong was cast into prison.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Minister of War Fu Zonglong was imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 十三年春閏正月乙酉，振真定饑。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, spring, intercalary first month, day yiyou: relief was distributed for the famine at Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the thirteenth year, on yiyou of the intercalary first month, famine relief was issued at Zhending.

sentences.zh: 戊子，振京師饑民。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: famine-stricken people of the capital were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi grain was distributed to starving people in the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，振山東饑。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Shandong famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao famine relief was sent to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子朔，祀日於東郊。

translations.literal: Second month, day renzi new moon: the sun was sacrificed to at the eastern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the second month the emperor sacrificed to the sun at the eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 戊午，總督陝西三邊侍郎鄭崇儉大破張獻忠於太平縣之瑪瑙山，獻忠走歸州。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Grand Coordinator of Shaanxi Three Frontiers and Vice Minister Zheng Chongjian greatly defeated Zhang Xianzhong at Agate Mountain in Taiping County; Xianzhong fled to Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Shaanxi Three Frontiers grand coordinator Zheng Chongjian routed Zhang Xianzhong at Agate Mountain in Taiping County, driving him toward Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以久旱求直言。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: because of long drought, blunt counsel was sought.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, after prolonged drought, the emperor called for blunt counsel.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，禱雨。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiashen: prayer for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiashen, the court prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，大風霾，詔清刑獄。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: great wind and dust haze; an edict ordered the clearing of criminal prisons.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu violent winds and dust storms swept the land, and the emperor ordered a review of the prisons.

sentences.zh: 戊子，罷各鎮內臣。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: inner attendants on the various garrisons were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the eunuch overseers at the regional garrisons were recalled.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賜魏藻德等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Wei Zaode and others were granted advanced scholar, secondary graduate, and other degrees in differing ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Wei Zaode and others received the advanced scholar and other degrees in varying ranks.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，振畿內饑。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the famine in the capital regions was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu famine relief was issued in the metropolitan region.

sentences.zh: 丁未，免河北三府逋賦。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: arrears in tax for the three prefectures of Hebei were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei overdue taxes in three Hebei prefectures were remitted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，逮江西巡撫僉都御史解學龍及所舉黃道周。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuwu: Jiangxi grand coordinator and Vice Censor-in-Chief Xie Xuelong and his nominee Huang Daozhou were arrested.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuwu, Jiangxi grand coordinator Xie Xuelong and Huang Daozhou, whom he had recommended, were arrested.

sentences.zh: 己卯，吏部尚書謝升為禮部尚書，禮部侍郎陳演以原官並兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Minister of Personnel Xie Sheng was made Minister of Rites; Vice Minister of Rites Chen Yan retained his original post and was concurrently made Grand Secretary of the Eastern Lodge, participating in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Personnel minister Xie Sheng was moved to minister of rites, and Rites vice minister Chen Yan was retained in his post while also joining the Eastern Lodge as grand secretary with a seat in confidential deliberations.

sentences.zh: 五月，羅汝才犯夔州，石砫女官秦良玉連戰卻之。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Luo Rucai invaded Kuizhou; female commander of Shizhu Qin Liangyu repeatedly fought and repulsed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Luo Rucai attacked Kuizhou; Qin Liangyu, the female commander of Shizhu, fought him in repeated engagements and drove him back.

sentences.zh: 甲申，祀地於北郊。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the earth was sacrificed to at the northern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the emperor sacrificed to Earth at the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，姚明恭致仕。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Yao Minggong retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Yao Minggong retired.

sentences.zh: 六月辛亥朔，總兵官賀人龍等分道逐賊，敗之，羅汝才走大寧。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinhai new moon: regional commanders He Renlong and others pursued the bandits by separate routes and defeated them; Luo Rucai fled to Daning.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai new moon of the sixth month regional commanders led by He Renlong pursued the rebels on several fronts, routed them, and drove Luo Rucai toward Daning.

sentences.zh: 庚午，蔡國用卒。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Cai Guoyong died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Cai Guoyong died.

sentences.zh: 辛未，薛國觀罷。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Xue Guanguan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Xue Guanguan was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰朔，畿內捕蝗。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengchen new moon: locusts were hunted in the capital regions.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen new moon of the seventh month locust-catching campaigns were launched across the metropolitan region.

sentences.zh: 己丑，發帑振被蝗州縣。

translations.literal: Day jichou: treasury funds were distributed to relieve locust-stricken prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou state funds were dispensed to counties and prefectures stricken by locusts.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，左良玉及京營總兵官孫應元等大破羅汝才於興山。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Zuo Liangyu and capital-garrison regional commander Sun Yingyuan greatly defeated Luo Rucai at Xingshan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Zuo Liangyu and capital-garrison commander Sun Yingyuan routed Luo Rucai at Xingshan.

sentences.zh: 汝才走巫山，與張獻忠合。

translations.literal: Rucai fled to Wushan and united with Zhang Xianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Rucai retreated to Wushan and joined forces with Zhang Xianzhong.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，振江北饑。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiaxu: famine north of the Yangzi was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiaxu, famine relief was sent to the region north of the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 九月，陝西官軍圍李自成于巴西魚腹山中，自成走免。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Shaanxi government troops besieged Li Zicheng in Fish-Belly Mountain in Ba; Zicheng fled and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Shaanxi government forces besieged Li Zicheng in Fish-Belly Mountain in Ba county, but Zicheng broke out and escaped.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，張獻忠陷大昌，總兵官張令戰死。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Zhang Xianzhong took Dachang; regional commander Zhang Ling died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Zhang Xianzhong took Dachang; regional commander Zhang Ling was killed in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 尋陷劍州、綿州。

translations.literal: Soon Jianzhou and Mianzhou fell.
translations.idiomatic: He soon overran Jianzhou and Mianzhou as well.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑，熊文燦棄市。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guichou: Xiong Wencan was executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guichou, Xiong Wencan was put to death in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 十一月，楊嗣昌進軍重慶。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: Yang Sichang advanced the army to Chongqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Yang Sichang marched his army into Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，祀天於南郊。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Heaven was sacrificed to at the southern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the emperor offered sacrifice to Heaven at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 戊子，南京地震。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Nanjing was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未朔，嚴軍機抄傳之禁。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingwei new moon: the prohibition on leaking military intelligence copies was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei new moon of the twelfth month the court tightened the ban on unauthorized copying or transmission of military dispatches.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，張獻忠陷瀘州。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Zhang Xianzhong took Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Zhang Xianzhong took Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，逮薛國觀。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Xue Guanguan was arrested.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Xue Guanguan was arrested.

sentences.zh: 是月，李自成自湖廣走河南，饑民附之，連陷宜陽、永甯，殺萬安王采崿，陷偃師，勢大熾。

translations.literal: That month, Li Zicheng from Huguang fled into Henan; famine refugees attached to him; he took Yiyang and Yongning in succession, killed the Prince of Wan'an Zhu Cairuo, took Yanshi; his momentum greatly flared.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Zicheng marched from Huguang into Henan, swelling his ranks with starving refugees; he seized Yiyang and Yongning in succession, killed Prince Zhu Cairuo of Wan'an, overran Yanshi, and his power surged.

sentences.zh: 是年，兩畿、山東、河南、山、陝旱蝗，人相食。

translations.literal: That year the Two Capitals, Shandong, Henan, Shanxi, and Shaanxi suffered drought and locusts; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: That year drought and locusts struck the Two Capitals, Shandong, Henan, Shanxi, and Shaanxi, and people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月辛巳，祈穀於南郊。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, spring, first month, day xinsi: prayer for grain was offered at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourteenth year, first month, on xinsi, the court offered prayer for grain at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 己丑，總兵官猛如虎追張獻忠及於開縣之黃陵城，敗績，參將劉士傑等戰死，賊遂東下。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Regional Commander Meng Ruhu pursued Zhang Xianzhong to Huanglingcheng in Kaizhou, suffered defeat; Vice Commander Liu Shijie and others died in battle; the bandits then went east.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou regional commander Meng Ruhu pursued Zhang Xianzhong to Huanglingcheng in Kaizhou, was defeated, and vice commander Liu Shijie and others were killed; the rebels then drove eastward.

sentences.zh: 丙申，李自成陷河南，福王常洵遇害，前兵部尚書呂維祺等死之。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Li Zicheng took Henan; Prince Fu Changxun was killed; former Minister of War Lü Weiqi and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Li Zicheng captured Henan; Prince Fu Changxun was killed, and former minister of war Lü Weiqi and others died with him.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，詔以時事多艱，災異疊見，痛自刻責，停今歲行刑，諸犯俱減等論。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiyou: an edict, citing hard times and repeated calamities, ordered stern self-reproach, suspended executions for the year, and reduced all sentences by one degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiyou, citing hard times and repeated portents, the emperor issued an edict of stern self-reproach, suspended executions for the year, and reduced all criminal sentences by one degree.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，張獻忠陷襄陽，襄王翊銘、貴陽王常法並遇害，副使張克儉等死之。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Zhang Xianzhong took Xiangyang; Princes Xiang Yiming and Guiyang Changfa were both killed; Vice Commissioner Zhang Kexian and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Zhang Xianzhong captured Xiangyang; princes Xiang Yiming and Guiyang Changfa were both killed, and vice commissioner Zhang Kexian and others died defending the city.

sentences.zh: 戊午，李自成攻開封，周王恭枵、巡按御史高名衡拒卻之。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Li Zicheng attacked Kaifeng; Prince Zhou Gonggong and Investigating Censor Gao Mingheng repulsed him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Li Zicheng attacked Kaifeng, but Prince Zhou Gonggong and investigating censor Gao Mingheng drove him back.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，張獻忠陷光州。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Zhang Xianzhong took Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Zhang Xianzhong captured Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，召閣臣、九卿、科道于乾清宮左室。

translations.literal: Day jisi: grand secretaries, the Nine Ministers, and censors were summoned to the left chamber of Qianqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the emperor summoned the grand secretaries, the Nine Ministers, and the censors to the left chamber of Qianqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 命駙馬都尉冉興讓等齎帑金振恤河南被難宗室。

translations.literal: Chief Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-law Ran Xingrang and others were ordered to carry treasury silver to relieve Henan princes of the imperial clan who had suffered in the disaster.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered chief commandant of the imperial son-in-law Ran Xingrang and others to carry treasury silver to relieve the Henan princes of the imperial clan who had suffered in the disaster.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子朔，楊嗣昌自四川還，至荊州卒。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingzi new moon: Yang Sichang returned from Sichuan and died at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi new moon of the third month Yang Sichang returned from Sichuan and died at Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，禱雨。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: prayer for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the court offered prayer for rain.

sentences.zh: 丙申，洪承疇會八鎮兵于寧遠。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Hong Chengchou assembled troops from eight garrisons at Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Hong Chengchou assembled the armies of eight garrisons at Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，逮鄭崇儉下獄，尋棄市。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Zheng Chongqian was arrested and cast into prison; soon after he was executed at market.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Zheng Chongqian was arrested and imprisoned; soon afterward he was executed in public.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子，大清兵攻錦州，祖大壽拒守。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renzi: Great Qing forces attacked Jinzhou; Zu Dashou held them off.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on renzi, Great Qing forces attacked Jinzhou, and Zu Dashou held the defense.

sentences.zh: 己未，總督三邊侍郎丁啟睿為兵部尚書，督師討賊。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Ding Qirui, grand coordinator of the Three Frontiers and vice minister of war, was made Minister of War and supreme commander to campaign against the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Ding Qirui, grand coordinator of the Three Frontiers and vice minister of war, was appointed minister of war and supreme commander to campaign against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 五月庚辰，範復粹致仕。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengchen: Fan Fucui retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengchen, Fan Fucui retired from office.

sentences.zh: 釋傅宗龍於獄，命為兵部侍郎，總督陝西三邊軍務，討李自成。

translations.literal: Fu Zonglong was released from prison and appointed Vice Minister of War, with overall command of Shaanxi Three Frontiers military affairs to campaign against Li Zicheng.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Zonglong was released from prison, appointed vice minister of war, and given overall command of Shaanxi Three Frontiers military affairs to campaign against Li Zicheng.

sentences.zh: 戊子，祀地於北郊。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: sacrifice to Earth was offered at the Northern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the court offered sacrifice to Earth at the Northern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 六月，兩畿、山東、河南、浙江、湖廣旱蝗，山東寇起。

translations.literal: Sixth month: the Two Capitals, Shandong, Henan, Zhejiang, and Huguang suffered drought and locusts; bandits rose in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month drought and locusts afflicted the Two Capitals, Shandong, Henan, Zhejiang, and Huguang, and bandits rose in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，李自成攻鄧州，楊文岳、總兵官虎大威擊敗之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jimao: Li Zicheng attacked Dengzhou; Yang Wenyue and Regional Commander Hu Dawei defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jimao, Li Zicheng attacked Dengzhou, but Yang Wenyue and regional commander Hu Dawei defeated him.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，洪承疇援錦州，駐師松山。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Hong Chengchou went to relieve Jinzhou and encamped at Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Hong Chengchou marched to relieve Jinzhou and encamped at Songshan.

sentences.zh: 是月，臨清運河涸。

translations.literal: That month the Grand Canal at Linqing dried up.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Grand Canal at Linqing ran dry.

sentences.zh: 京師大疫。

translations.literal: A great plague struck the capital.
translations.idiomatic: A great plague broke out in the capital.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳，援兵戰于松山，陽和總兵官楊國柱敗沒。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yisi: relief troops fought at Songshan; Yang Guozhu, regional commander of Yanghe, was defeated and lost.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yisi, relief troops fought at Songshan; Yang Guozhu, regional commander of Yanghe, was defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，賜薛國觀死。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Xue Guanguan was granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Xue Guanguan was ordered to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，重建太學成，釋奠于先師孔子。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: reconstruction of the Imperial Academy was completed; a libation sacrifice was offered to Confucius the First Teacher.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou reconstruction of the Imperial Academy was completed, and a libation sacrifice was offered to Confucius the First Teacher.

sentences.zh: 甲子，總兵官吳三桂、王樸自松山遁，諸軍夜潰。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Regional Commanders Wu Sangui and Wang Pu fled from Songshan; the armies collapsed in flight by night.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi regional commanders Wu Sangui and Wang Pu fled from Songshan, and the armies broke and fled in the night.

sentences.zh: 是月，左良玉大敗張獻忠於信陽。

translations.literal: That month Zuo Liangyu inflicted a great defeat on Zhang Xianzhong at Xinyang.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zuo Liangyu routed Zhang Xianzhong in a great victory at Xinyang.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，傅宗龍帥師次新蔡，與總督保定侍郎楊文岳軍會。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingchou: Fu Zonglong led his army to station at Xincai and joined forces with Yang Wenyue, grand coordinator of Baoding and vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingchou, Fu Zonglong led his army to Xincai and joined forces with Yang Wenyue, grand coordinator of Baoding and vice minister.

sentences.zh: 己卯，遇賊，賀人龍師潰，宗龍被圍，文岳走陳州。

translations.literal: Day jimao: they met the bandits; He Renlong's division broke and fled; Zonglong was surrounded; Wenyue withdrew to Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao they encountered the rebels; He Renlong's division broke and fled, Zonglong was surrounded, and Wenyue withdrew to Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，周延儒、賀逢聖復入閣。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Zhou Yanru and He Fengsheng re-entered the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Zhou Yanru and He Fengsheng returned to the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，封皇子慈炯為定王。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the prince Cijiong was enfeoffed as Prince Ding.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the prince Cijiong was enfeoffed as Prince Ding.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，傅宗龍潰圍出，趨項城，被執死之。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Fu Zonglong broke out of the encirclement, hastened toward Xiangcheng, was captured and killed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Fu Zonglong broke out of the encirclement and hurried toward Xiangcheng, but was captured and killed.

sentences.zh: 賊屠項城及商水、扶溝。

translations.literal: The bandits massacred Xiangcheng as well as Shangshui and Fugou.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels massacred the populations of Xiangcheng, Shangshui, and Fugou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，李自成、羅汝才陷葉縣，守將劉國能死之。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Li Zicheng and Luo Rucai took Yexian; defending general Liu Guoneng was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Li Zicheng and Luo Rucai captured Yexian; defending general Liu Guoneng was killed.

sentences.zh: 是月，官軍破張獻忠於英山之望雲寨。

translations.literal: That month government troops defeated Zhang Xianzhong at Wangyunzhai in Yingshan.
translations.idiomatic: That month government troops defeated Zhang Xianzhong at Wangyunzhai in Yingshan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guimao new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao new moon of the tenth month of winter there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，李自成陷南陽，唐王聿鏌遇害，總兵官猛如虎等死之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingzi: Li Zicheng took Nanyang; Prince Tang Yulang was killed; Regional Commander Meng Ruhu and others died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingzi, Li Zicheng captured Nanyang; Prince Tang Yulang was killed, and regional commander Meng Ruhu and others died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 十二月，李自成連陷洧川、許州、長葛、鄢陵。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Li Zicheng in succession took Weichuan, Xuzhou, Changge, and Yanling.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Li Zicheng captured Weichuan, Xuzhou, Changge, and Yanling in succession.

sentences.zh: 甲子，戍解學龍、黃道周。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Xie Xuelong and Huang Daozhou were released from banishment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Xie Xuelong and Huang Daozhou were released from exile.

sentences.zh: 李自成、羅汝才合攻開封，周王恭枵、巡撫都御史高名衡拒守。

translations.literal: Li Zicheng and Luo Rucai together attacked Kaifeng; Prince Zhou Gonggong and Grand Coordinator Gao Mingheng held the defense.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zicheng and Luo Rucai jointly besieged Kaifeng; Prince Zhou Gonggong and grand coordinator Gao Mingheng held the defense.

sentences.zh: 十五年春正月癸未，孫傳庭為兵部侍郎，督京軍救開封。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, spring, first month, day guimao: Sun Chuanting was made Vice Minister of War and ordered to lead the capital army to relieve Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifteenth year, first month, on guimao, Sun Chuanting was appointed vice minister of war and ordered to lead the capital army to relieve Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，楊文嶽援開封，賊解去，南陷西華。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Yang Wenyue relieved Kaifeng; the bandits withdrew and went south to take Xihua.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Yang Wenyue relieved Kaifeng; the rebels lifted the siege and marched south to capture Xihua.

sentences.zh: 戊子，免天下十二年以前逋賦。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: tax arrears from more than twelve years back were remitted throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi tax arrears dating from more than twelve years back were remitted throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 是月，山東賊陷張秋、東平，劫漕艘。

translations.literal: That month Shandong bandits took Zhangqiu and Dongping and robbed grain transport vessels.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shandong bandits captured Zhangqiu and Dongping and plundered grain transport vessels on the canal.

sentences.zh: 太監王裕民、劉元斌帥禁兵會兗東官軍討平之。

translations.literal: Eunuchs Wang Yumin and Liu Yuanbin led palace troops to join eastern Shandong government forces and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuchs Wang Yumin and Liu Yuanbin led palace troops to join government forces in eastern Shandong and pacified the rebels.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，振山東就撫亂民。

translations.literal: Second month, day wushen: relief was extended to pacified rebels in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wushen, relief was extended to the pacified rebels of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，總督陝西都御史汪喬年次襄城，遇賊，賀人龍等奔入關，喬年被圍。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Wang Qiaonian, grand coordinator of Shaanxi, reached Xiangcheng, met the bandits; He Renlong and others fled back through the passes; Qiaonian was surrounded.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Wang Qiaonian, grand coordinator of Shaanxi, reached Xiangcheng and encountered the rebels; He Renlong and others fled back through the passes, and Qiaonian was surrounded.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，城陷，被執死之。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: the city fell; he was captured and killed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the city fell; he was captured and killed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，大清兵克松山，洪承疇降，巡撫都御史丘民仰，總兵官曹變蛟、王廷臣，副總兵江翥、饒勳等死之。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Great Qing forces captured Songshan; Hong Chengchou surrendered; Grand Coordinator Qiu Minyang, Regional Commanders Cao Bianjiao and Wang Tingchen, and Vice Commanders Jiang Zhu and Rao Xun and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Great Qing forces captured Songshan; Hong Chengchou surrendered, while grand coordinator Qiu Minyang, regional commanders Cao Bianjiao and Wang Tingchen, and vice commanders Jiang Zhu and Rao Xun and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 是月，孫傳庭總督三邊軍務。

translations.literal: That month Sun Chuanting took overall command of Three Frontiers military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: That month Sun Chuanting was given overall command of Three Frontiers military affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月，李自成陷陳州。

translations.literal: Third month: Li Zicheng took Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Li Zicheng captured Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，魏照乘致仕。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Wei Zhaosheng retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Wei Zhaosheng retired from office.

sentences.zh: 己卯，祖大壽以錦州降於大清。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Zu Dashou surrendered Jinzhou to the Great Qing.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Zu Dashou surrendered Jinzhou to the Great Qing.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，李自成陷睢州、太康、寧陵、考城。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Li Zicheng took Suizhou, Taikang, Ningling, and Kaocheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Li Zicheng captured Suizhou, Taikang, Ningling, and Kaocheng.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，封皇子慈炤為永王。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the prince Cizhao was enfeoffed as Prince Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the prince Cizhao was enfeoffed as Prince Yong.

sentences.zh: 丙申，李自成陷歸德。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Li Zicheng took Guide.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Li Zicheng captured Guide.

sentences.zh: 是春，江北賊陷含山、和州，南京戒嚴。

translations.literal: That spring bandits in Jiangbei took Hanshan and Hezhou; Nanjing was placed under martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: That spring bandits in Jiangbei captured Hanshan and Hezhou, and Nanjing was placed under martial alert.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，李自成復圍開封。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guihai: Li Zicheng again besieged Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guihai, Li Zicheng again besieged Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，削謝升籍。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Xie Sheng was struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Xie Sheng was struck from the official rolls.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，孫傳庭入關，誅賀人龍。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jisi: Sun Chuanting entered the passes and executed He Renlong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jisi, Sun Chuanting entered the passes and executed He Renlong.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，張獻忠陷廬州。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Zhang Xianzhong took Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Zhang Xianzhong captured Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，王樸棄市。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Wang Pu was executed at market.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Wang Pu was executed in public.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，賀逢聖致仕。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wushen: He Fengsheng retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wushen, He Fengsheng retired from office.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，張四知致仕。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Zhang Sizhi retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Zhang Sizhi retired from office.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔天下停刑三年。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: an edict ordered a three-year suspension of executions throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin an edict ordered a three-year suspension of executions throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 己未，詹事蔣德璟、黃景昉，戎政侍郎吳甡，俱禮部尚書兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Supervisors of the Heir Apparent Jiang Dejing and Huang Jingfang, and Vice Minister for Military Administration Wu Shen, were all made Ministers of Rites with concurrent posts as Grand Secretaries of the Eastern Lodge, participating in state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei supervisors of the heir apparent Jiang Dejing and Huang Jingfang, together with vice minister for military administration Wu Shen, were all appointed ministers of rites and grand secretaries of the Eastern Lodge with seats in state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔孫傳庭出關。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: an edict ordered Sun Chuanting to leave the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen an edict ordered Sun Chuanting to march out of the passes.

sentences.zh: 兵部侍郎侯恂督左良玉軍援開封。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of War Hou Xun supervised Zuo Liangyu's army to relieve Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Vice minister of war Hou Xun took command of Zuo Liangyu's army to relieve Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以會推閣臣下吏部尚書李日宣六人於獄，謫戍有差。

translations.literal: Day renxu: because of the collective recommendation for grand secretary, Minister of Personnel Li Rixuan and six others were cast into prison; banishment was assigned in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, over the collective recommendation for grand secretary, minister of personnel Li Rixuan and six others were imprisoned and banished in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 甲子，祀地於北郊。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: sacrifice to Earth was offered at the Northern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the court offered sacrifice to Earth at the Northern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 是月，築壇親祭死事文武大臣。

translations.literal: That month an altar was built for the emperor personally to sacrifice to civil and military officials who had died in service.
translations.idiomatic: That month an altar was built for the emperor to sacrifice in person to civil and military officials who had died in service.

sentences.zh: 山西總兵官許定國援開封，潰于沁水，甯武兵潰于覃懷。

translations.literal: Shanxi Regional Commander Xu Dingguo went to relieve Kaifeng but was routed at Qinshui; Ningwu troops were routed at Tanhuai.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi regional commander Xu Dingguo marched to relieve Kaifeng but was routed at Qinshui, and Ningwu troops were routed at Tanhuai.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，左良玉、虎大威、楊德政、方國安四鎮兵潰於硃仙鎮。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jisi: the armies of four garrisons—Zuo Liangyu, Hu Dawei, Yang Dezheng, and Fang Guo'an—were routed at Zhuxian Town.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jisi, the armies of four garrisons under Zuo Liangyu, Hu Dawei, Yang Dezheng, and Fang Guo'an were routed at Zhuxian Town.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，安慶兵變，殺都指揮徐良憲，官軍討定之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengxu: troops at Anqing mutinied and killed Commander Xu Liangxian; government forces pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengxu, troops at Anqing mutinied and killed commander Xu Liangxian; government forces then pacified the mutiny.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，釋黃道周於戍所，復其官。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Huang Daozhou was released from banishment and restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Huang Daozhou was released from exile and restored to office.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，兵部尚書陳新甲下獄，尋棄市。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Minister of War Chen Xinjin was cast into prison; soon after he was executed at market.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao minister of war Chen Xinjin was imprisoned; soon afterward he was executed in public.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，賊決河灌開封。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renwu: the bandits breached the Yellow River to flood Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renwu, the rebels breached the Yellow River to flood Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 癸未，城圮，士民溺死者數十萬人。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the walls collapsed; several hundred thousand soldiers and civilians drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the city walls collapsed, and several hundred thousand soldiers and civilians drowned.

sentences.zh: 己丑，孫傳庭帥師赴河南。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Sun Chuanting led his army toward Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Sun Chuanting led his army toward Henan.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，鳳陽總兵官黃得功、劉良佐大敗張獻忠於潛山。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Fengyang Regional Commanders Huang Degong and Liu Liangzuo inflicted a great defeat on Zhang Xianzhong at Qianshan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Fengyang regional commanders Huang Degong and Liu Liangzuo routed Zhang Xianzhong in a great victory at Qianshan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉，孫傳庭敗績於郟縣，走入關。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinyou: Sun Chuanting was defeated at Yexian and fled back into the passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinyou, Sun Chuanting was defeated at Yexian and fled back into the passes.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，援汴總兵官劉超據永城反。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingmao: Liu Chao, regional commander sent to relieve Bian, held Yongcheng in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingmao, Liu Chao, the regional commander sent to relieve Bian, seized Yongcheng and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 庚午，發帑振開封被難宗室兵民。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: treasury funds were issued to relieve princes of the imperial clan, troops, and civilians who had suffered at Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu treasury funds were issued to relieve the princes of the imperial clan, troops, and civilians who had suffered at Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 壬申，大清兵分道入塞，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Great Qing forces entered the frontier by several routes; the capital was placed under martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Great Qing forces crossed the frontier by several routes, and the capital was placed under martial alert.

sentences.zh: 命勳臣分守九門，太監王承恩督察城守。

translations.literal: Titled nobles were ordered to hold the Nine Gates separately; eunuch Wang Chengen supervised the defense of the city.
translations.idiomatic: Titled nobles were ordered to hold the Nine Gates in separate posts, and eunuch Wang Chengen supervised the defense of the city.

sentences.zh: 詔舉堪督師大將者。

translations.literal: An edict called for recommendation of men fit to serve as supreme commander and great general.
translations.idiomatic: An edict called for recommendations of men fit to serve as supreme commander and great general.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，征諸鎮入援。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: levies were ordered from the various garrisons for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin levies were ordered from the various garrisons to march to the relief of the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，大清兵克薊州。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Great Qing forces captured Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Great Qing forces captured Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，薊鎮總督趙光抃提調援兵。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Zhao Guangbian, grand coordinator of Ji, took command of relief troops.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Zhao Guangbian, grand coordinator of Ji, took command of the relief troops.

sentences.zh: 戊子，張獻忠陷無為。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Zhang Xianzhong took Wuwei.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Zhang Xianzhong captured Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 己丑，遼東督師侍郎范志完入援。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Fan Zhiwan, supervisor-general of Liaodong, came with relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Fan Zhiwan, supervisor-general of Liaodong, marched in with relief forces.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸卯，下詔罪己，求直言。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day guimao: an edict of self-blame was issued and forthright counsel was sought.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on guimao, the emperor issued an edict blaming himself and calling for forthright counsel.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大清兵南下，畿南郡邑多不守。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Great Qing forces marched south; many commanderies and counties south of the capital region did not hold.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Great Qing forces marched south, and many commanderies and counties south of the capital region fell one after another.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，起廢將。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: dismissed generals were reappointed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi dismissed generals were reappointed to service.

sentences.zh: 是月，李自成陷汝甯，前總督侍郎楊文岳、僉事王世琮不屈死。

translations.literal: That month Li Zicheng took Runing; former Grand Coordinator Yang Wenyue and Commissioner Wang Shizong refused to submit and were killed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Zicheng captured Runing; former grand coordinator Yang Wenyue and commissioner Wang Shizong refused to submit and were killed.

sentences.zh: 十二月，大清兵趨曹、濮，山東州縣相繼下，魯王以派自殺。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Great Qing forces advanced toward Cao and Pu; Shandong prefectures and counties fell one after another; Prince Lu killed himself together with his household.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Great Qing forces advanced toward Cao and Pu; Shandong prefectures and counties fell in succession, and Prince Lu killed himself together with his household.

sentences.zh: 己巳，李自成陷襄陽，據之。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Li Zicheng took Xiangyang and held it.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Li Zicheng captured Xiangyang and held it.

sentences.zh: 左良玉奔承天，尋走武昌。

translations.literal: Zuo Liangyu fled to Chengtian, then soon after to Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Liangyu fled to Chengtian and soon afterward withdrew to Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 賊分兵下德安、彝陵、荊門，遂陷荊州。

translations.literal: The bandits divided their forces to descend on Dean, Yiling, and Jingmen, then took Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels split their forces to strike Dean, Yiling, and Jingmen, then captured Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，焚獻陵。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the Xian Mausoleum was burned.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the Xian Mausoleum was burned.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月丁酉，李自成陷承天，巡撫都御史宋一鶴、留守沈壽崇等死之。

translations.literal: Chongzhen sixteen, spring, first month, day dingyou: Li Zicheng took Chengtian; Grand Coordinator Song Yihe, garrison commander Shen Shoucong, and others died.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongzhen sixteen, in the first month of spring, on dingyou, Li Zicheng captured Chengtian; grand coordinator Song Yihe, garrison commander Shen Shoucong, and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，張獻忠陷蘄州。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Zhang Xianzhong took Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Zhang Xianzhong captured Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Second month, day yichou new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou new moon of the second month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己巳，範志完、趙光抃會師于平原。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Fan Zhiwan and Zhao Guangbiao united their armies at Pingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Fan Zhiwan and Zhao Guangbiao joined forces at Pingyuan.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，李自成殺羅汝才，並其眾。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengzi: Li Zicheng killed Luo Rucai and absorbed his followers.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengzi, Li Zicheng killed Luo Rucai and absorbed his following.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命大學士吳甡督師討賊。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Grand Secretary Wu Lin was ordered to take supreme command and campaign against the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Grand Secretary Wu Lin was ordered to take supreme command against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 丁未，賊陷武岡，殺岷王企昪。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the bandits took Wugang and killed Prince Min Qi Bian.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the rebels captured Wugang and killed Prince Min, Qi Bian.

sentences.zh: 張獻忠陷黃州。

translations.literal: Zhang Xianzhong took Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xianzhong captured Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，周延儒自請督師，許之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingmao: Zhou Yanru volunteered to take supreme command; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingmao, Zhou Yanru volunteered to take supreme command, and the court assented.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，大清兵北歸，戰於螺山，總兵官張登科、和應薦敗沒，八鎮兵皆潰。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Great Qing troops returned north; at Luoshan regional commanders Zhang Dengke and He Yingjian were defeated and killed, and the troops of the eight garrisons all broke.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Great Qing forces marched north; at Luoshan regional commanders Zhang Dengke and He Yingjian were defeated and killed, and the armies of the eight garrisons all fled in rout.

sentences.zh: 是月，劉超平。

translations.literal: That month, Liu Chao was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: That month Liu Chao was suppressed.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳朔，張獻忠陷漢陽。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guisi new moon: Zhang Xianzhong took Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi new moon of the fifth month Zhang Xianzhong captured Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，周延儒還京師。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Zhou Yanru returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Zhou Yanru returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙午，修撰魏藻德為少詹事兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Hanlin Academician Wei Zaode was made Junior Mentor and concurrently Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, participating in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Hanlin academician Wei Zaode was made junior mentor and concurrently grand secretary of the Eastern Pavilion with a seat in confidential state affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊申，吳甡罷。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Wu Lin was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Wu Lin was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，周延儒罷。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Zhou Yanru was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Zhou Yanru was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，張獻忠陷武昌，沈楚王華奎于江，在籍大學士賀逢聖等死之。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Zhang Xianzhong took Wuchang, drowned Prince Chu Hua Kui in the river, and Grand Secretary He Fengsheng and others in retirement died.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Zhang Xianzhong captured Wuchang, drowned Prince Chu Hua Kui in the Yangzi, and retired grand secretary He Fengsheng and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，詔免直省殘破州縣三餉及一切常賦二年。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guihai: an edict remitted the three levies and all regular taxes for two years in devastated prefectures and counties of the direct provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guihai, an edict remitted the three levies and all regular taxes for two years in the ravaged prefectures and counties of the metropolitan provinces.

sentences.zh: 己卯，逮範志完下獄。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Fan Zhiwan was arrested and cast into prison.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Fan Zhiwan was arrested and imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，雷震奉先殿獸吻，敕修省。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: lightning struck the beast finials of the Hall of Imperial Ancestors; an edict ordered self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu lightning struck the beast finials of the Hall of Imperial Ancestors, and the emperor ordered repentance and reform.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，親鞫范志完于中左門。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingyou: the emperor personally tried Fan Zhiwan at the Central Left Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingyou, the emperor personally tried Fan Zhiwan at the Central Left Gate.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，親鞫前文選郎中吳昌時于中左門，征周延儒聽勘。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the emperor personally tried former Director of Personnel Wu Changshi at the Central Left Gate and summoned Zhou Yanru to answer charges.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the emperor personally tried former director of personnel Wu Changshi at the Central Left Gate and summoned Zhou Yanru to stand trial.

sentences.zh: 己未，戒廷臣私謁閣臣。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: court ministers were forbidden to pay private calls on grand secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the court forbade ministers to pay private visits to grand secretaries.

sentences.zh: 京師自二月至於是月大疫，詔釋輕犯，發帑療治，瘞五城暴骸。

translations.literal: From the second month until this month a great plague raged in the capital; an edict released minor offenders, disbursed treasury funds for treatment, and buried the unburied dead in the five wards.
translations.idiomatic: From the second month until this month a great plague raged in the capital; the court released minor offenders, disbursed treasury funds for treatment, and buried the unburied dead of the five wards.

sentences.zh: 八月壬戌朔，左良玉復武昌、漢陽。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renxu new moon: Zuo Liangyu recovered Wuchang and Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu new moon of the eighth month Zuo Liangyu recovered Wuchang and Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，張獻忠陷岳州。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Zhang Xianzhong took Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Zhang Xianzhong captured Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，陷長沙。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: he took Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he captured Changsha.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，陷衡州。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: he took Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he captured Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，張獻忠陷寶慶。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingshen: Zhang Xianzhong took Baozing.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingshen, Zhang Xianzhong captured Baozing.

sentences.zh: 己亥，黃景昉致仕。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Huang Jingfang retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Huang Jingfang retired from office.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，孫傳庭復寶豐，進次郟縣，李自成迎戰，擊敗之。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Sun Chuanting recovered Baofeng, advanced to Jia County, and when Li Zicheng came out to give battle, defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Sun Chuanting recovered Baofeng, advanced to Jia County, and when Li Zicheng came out to fight, routed him.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，張獻忠陷永州，巡按御史劉熙祚死之。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Zhang Xianzhong took Yongzhou; touring censor Liu Xizuo died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Zhang Xianzhong captured Yongzhou; touring censor Liu Xizuo was killed.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，賜楊廷鑒等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Yang Tingjian and others were granted jinshi with palace degrees and various ranks according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Yang Tingjian and others received jinshi titles, palace degrees, and ranks according to merit.

sentences.zh: 壬子，孫傳庭兵以乏食引退，賊追及之，還戰大敗，傳庭以餘眾退保潼關。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Sun Chuanting's army, short of food, withdrew; the bandits overtook them, fought again, and were utterly defeated; Chuanting with the remnant force fell back to hold Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Sun Chuanting's army, short of provisions, withdrew; the rebels overtook them, fought again, and inflicted a crushing defeat; Chuanting fell back with the remnant to hold Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 是月，鳳陽地屢震。

translations.literal: That month, Fengyang repeatedly shook with earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fengyang was shaken repeatedly by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉朔，享太廟。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinyou new moon: the imperial ancestors were honored at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou new moon of the tenth month of winter the imperial ancestors were honored at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，李自成陷潼關，督師尚書孫傳庭死之。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Li Zicheng took Tong Pass; supreme commander Sun Chuanting died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Li Zicheng captured Tong Pass; supreme commander Sun Chuanting was killed.

sentences.zh: 賊連陷華州、渭南、臨潼。

translations.literal: The bandits in succession took Huazhou, Weinan, and Lintong.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels in succession captured Huazhou, Weinan, and Lintong.

sentences.zh: 命有司以贖鍰充餉。

translations.literal: Officials were ordered to use redemption fines to meet military pay.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were ordered to apply redemption fines to military pay.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，李自成屠商州。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Li Zicheng massacred Shangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Li Zicheng massacred Shangzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，張獻忠陷常德。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Zhang Xianzhong took Changde.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Zhang Xianzhong captured Changde.

sentences.zh: 壬申，李自成陷西安，秦王存樞降，巡撫都御史馮師孔、按察使黃絅等死之。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Li Zicheng took Xi'an; Prince Qin Cun Shu surrendered; Grand Coordinator Feng Shikong, surveillance commissioner Huang Jiong, and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Li Zicheng captured Xi'an; Prince Qin Cun Shu surrendered; grand coordinator Feng Shikong, surveillance commissioner Huang Jiong, and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，張獻忠陷吉安。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Zhang Xianzhong took Ji'an.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Zhang Xianzhong captured Ji'an.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，李自成陷延安，尋屠鳳翔。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiawu: Li Zicheng took Yan'an, then soon massacred Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiawu, Li Zicheng captured Yan'an and soon after massacred Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，祀天於南郊。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Heaven was sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the court sacrificed to Heaven at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，吏部侍郎李建泰、副都御史方岳貢並兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Vice Minister of Personnel Li Jiantai and Vice Censor-in-Chief Fang Yuegong were both made Grand Secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion, participating in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Vice Minister of Personnel Li Jiantai and Vice Censor-in-Chief Fang Yuegong were both made grand secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion with seats in confidential state affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，範志完、趙光抃棄市，戍吳甡于金齒。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Fan Zhiwan and Zhao Guangbiao were executed in the marketplace; Wu Lin was exiled to Jinchi.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Fan Zhiwan and Zhao Guangbiao were executed in the marketplace; Wu Lin was exiled to Jinchi.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，李自成陷榆林，兵備副使都任、在籍總兵官尤世威等死之。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Li Zicheng took Yulin; military vice commissioner Du Ren and retired regional commander You Shiwei and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Li Zicheng captured Yulin; military vice commissioner Du Ren, retired regional commander You Shiwei, and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 寧夏、慶陽相繼陷，韓王亶塉被執。

translations.literal: Ningxia and Qingyang fell in succession; Prince Han Tan Ji was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Ningxia and Qingyang fell in turn; Prince Han Tan Ji was taken captive.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬戌，張獻忠陷建昌。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renxu: Zhang Xianzhong took Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renxu, Zhang Xianzhong captured Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，周延儒有罪賜死。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Zhou Yanru, found guilty, was granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Zhou Yanru, found guilty, was granted death.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，張獻忠陷撫州。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Zhang Xianzhong took Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Zhang Xianzhong captured Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，賊渡河，陷平陽，山西州縣相繼潰降。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: the bandits crossed the river, took Pingyang, and Shanxi prefectures and counties in succession collapsed and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the rebels crossed the Yellow River, captured Pingyang, and Shanxi prefectures and counties collapsed and surrendered one after another.

sentences.zh: 甲申，賊陷甘州，巡撫都御史林日瑞、總兵官馬爌等死之。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the bandits took Ganzhou; Grand Coordinator Lin Rirui, regional commander Ma Kuang, and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the rebels captured Ganzhou; grand coordinator Lin Rirui, regional commander Ma Kuang, and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，左良玉復長沙。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Zuo Liangyu recovered Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Zuo Liangyu recovered Changsha.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅，琉球、哈密入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Siam, Ryukyu, and Hami sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Siam, Ryukyu, and Hami presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 十七年春正月庚寅朔，大風霾，鳳陽地震。

translations.literal: Chongzhen seventeen, spring, first month, day gengyin new moon: great wind and haze; Fengyang was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongzhen seventeen, on the gengyin new moon of the first month of spring, fierce wind and haze arose and Fengyang was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 庚子，李建泰自請措餉治兵討賊，許之。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Li Jiantai volunteered to raise funds, train troops, and campaign against the bandits; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Li Jiantai volunteered to raise funds, train troops, and campaign against the rebels; the court assented.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，幸正陽門樓，餞李建泰出師。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the emperor went to the Zhengyang Gate tower and saw Li Jiantai off as he took the field.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the emperor went to the Zhengyang Gate tower to see Li Jiantai off to the field.

sentences.zh: 南京地震。

translations.literal: Nanjing was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，工部尚書范景文、禮部侍郎丘瑜並兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Minister of Works Fan Jingwen and Vice Minister of Rites Qiu Yu were both made Grand Secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion, participating in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Minister of Works Fan Jingwen and Vice Minister of Rites Qiu Yu were both made grand secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion with seats in confidential state affairs.

sentences.zh: 是月，張獻忠入四川。

translations.literal: That month, Zhang Xianzhong entered Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhang Xianzhong entered Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，李自成陷汾州，別賊陷懷慶。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinyou: Li Zicheng took Fenzhou; a separate bandit force took Huaiqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinyou, Li Zicheng captured Fenzhou; a separate rebel column captured Huaiqing.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，陷太原，執晉王求桂，巡撫都御史蔡懋德等死之。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: he took Taiyuan, seized Prince Jin Qiu Gui, and Grand Coordinator Cai Maode and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he captured Taiyuan, seized Prince Jin Qiu Gui, and grand coordinator Cai Maode and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，下詔罪己。

translations.literal: Day renshen: an edict confessed faults.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the emperor issued an edict confessing his faults.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，潞安陷。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Lu'an fell.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Lu'an fell.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，議京師城守。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the defense of the capital was debated.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the court debated the defense of the capital.

sentences.zh: 李自成攻代州，總兵官周遇吉力戰，食盡，退守甯武關。

translations.literal: Li Zicheng attacked Daizhou; regional commander Zhou Yuji fought fiercely; when provisions were exhausted he fell back to hold Ningwu Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zicheng attacked Daizhou; regional commander Zhou Yuji fought fiercely, and when provisions ran out he fell back to hold Ningwu Pass.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賊別將陷固關，犯畿南。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: a separate bandit force took Gu Pass and raided south of the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou a separate rebel column captured Gu Pass and raided south of the capital region.

sentences.zh: 己卯，遣內臣高起潛、杜勳等十人監視諸邊及近畿要害。

translations.literal: Day jimao: ten inner eunuchs including Gao Qiqian and Du Xun were dispatched to supervise the various frontiers and key points near the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao ten inner eunuchs including Gao Qiqian and Du Xun were dispatched to supervise the frontier garrisons and key points near the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬午，真定知府丘茂華殺總督侍郎徐標，檄所屬降賊。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Zhending prefect Qiu Maohua killed Governor Xu Biao and issued orders to his subordinates to surrender to the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Zhending prefect Qiu Maohua killed Governor Xu Biao and ordered his subordinates to surrender to the rebels.

sentences.zh: 甲申，賊至彰德，趙王常㳛降。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the bandits reached Zhangde; Prince Zhao Chang Ruan surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the rebels reached Zhangde; Prince Zhao Chang Ruan surrendered.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔天下勤王。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: an edict called the realm to rush to the emperor's aid.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai an edict called the realm to rush to the emperor's aid.

sentences.zh: 命廷臣上戰守事宜。

translations.literal: Court ministers were ordered to submit plans for war and defense.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered ministers to submit plans for war and defense.

sentences.zh: 左都御史李邦華、右庶子李明睿請南遷及太子撫軍江南，皆不許。

translations.literal: Left Censor-in-Chief Li Banghua and Right Sub-Reader Li Mingrui requested removal to the south and that the crown prince take command in Jiangnan; both were refused.
translations.idiomatic: Left censor-in-chief Li Banghua and right sub-reader Li Mingrui urged removal to the south and that the crown prince take command in Jiangnan; both requests were refused.

sentences.zh: 戊子，陳演致仕。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Chen Yan retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Chen Yan retired from office.

sentences.zh: 李自成陷甯武，周遇吉力戰死之。

translations.literal: Li Zicheng took Ningwu; Zhou Yuji fought fiercely and died.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zicheng captured Ningwu; Zhou Yuji fought fiercely and was killed.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，賊至大同，總兵官姜瑰降賊，代王傳㸄遇害，巡撫都御史衛景瑗被執，自縊死。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengyin: the bandits reached Datong; regional commander Jiang Kui surrendered to the bandits; Prince Dai Chuan Ji met disaster; Grand Coordinator Wei Jingyuan was seized and hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengyin, the rebels reached Datong; regional commander Jiang Kui surrendered; Prince Dai Chuan Ji was killed; grand coordinator Wei Jingyuan was seized and hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，李建泰疏請南遷。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Li Jiantai memorialized requesting removal to the south.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Li Jiantai memorialized requesting removal to the south.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，召廷臣於平臺，示建泰疏，曰：「國君死社稷，朕將焉往？

translations.literal: Day renchen: court ministers were summoned to the terrace platform; Jiantai's memorial was shown, and the emperor said: "The ruler of a state dies for the altars of soil and grain — whither shall I go?
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the court was summoned to the terrace platform; Jiantai's memorial was read aloud, and the emperor said: "The ruler of a state dies for the altars of soil and grain — whither shall I go?

sentences.zh: 」李邦華等復請太子撫軍南京，不聽。

translations.literal: " Li Banghua and others again requested that the crown prince take command at Nanjing; the emperor would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: " Li Banghua and others again urged that the crown prince take command at Nanjing; the emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 蔣德璟致仕。

translations.literal: Jiang Dejing retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Dejing retired from office.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，封總兵官吳三桂、左良玉、唐通、黃得功俱為伯。

translations.literal: Day guisi: regional commanders Wu Sangui, Zuo Liangyu, Tang Tong, and Huang Degong were all enfeoffed as earls.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi regional commanders Wu Sangui, Zuo Liangyu, Tang Tong, and Huang Degong were all enfeoffed as earls.

sentences.zh: 甲午，征諸鎮兵入援。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: troops of the various garrisons were summoned to reinforce the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu troops of the various garrisons were summoned to reinforce the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙未，總兵官唐通入衛，命偕內臣杜之秩守居庸關。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: regional commander Tang Tong entered to defend the capital; he was ordered to guard Juyong Pass together with the eunuch Du Zhijie.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei regional commander Tang Tong entered to defend the capital; he was ordered to guard Juyong Pass together with eunuch Du Zhijie.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太監王承恩提督城守。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the eunuch Wang Chen'en was put in charge of the capital defense.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu eunuch Wang Chen'en was put in charge of the capital defense.

sentences.zh: 己亥，李自成至宣府，監視太監杜勳降，巡撫都御史硃之馮等死之。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Li Zicheng reached Xuanfu; supervising eunuch Du Xun surrendered; Grand Coordinator Zhu Zhifeng and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Li Zicheng reached Xuanfu; supervising eunuch Du Xun surrendered; grand coordinator Zhu Zhifeng and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，唐通、杜之秩降于自成，賊遂入關。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Tang Tong and Du Zhijie surrendered to Zicheng; the bandits then entered the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Tang Tong and Du Zhijie surrendered to Zicheng; the rebels then entered the passes.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，陷昌平。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Changping fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Changping fell.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賊犯京師，京營兵潰。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the bandits attacked the capital; capital garrison troops broke.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the rebels attacked the capital; capital garrison troops broke.

sentences.zh: 丙午，日晡，外城陷。
